name: Robin Carnahan
desc: Administrator of the General Services Administration since 2021
summary: Robin Colleen Carnahan (born August 4, 1961) is an American businesswoman, lawyer, and politician,  who previously served as the Missouri Secretary of State and served as the Administrator of General Services in the Biden administration from 2021 to 2025. She is the daughter of Missouri politicians Mel and Jean Carnahan. In 2010, she was the Democratic nominee in the U.S. Senate election in Missouri to replace retiring Republican Senator Kit Bond but lost to Roy Blunt.
